content.text:
releases.json holds this month's image versions for some of the services under services/.

For every service releases.json names, put that version on its image tag in services/<name>/service.yaml and on its tag line in deploy/manifest.yaml. Leave every service releases.json does not name exactly as it is, and do not reformat, reorder or re-indent anything.

Work from the files as they are: do not create, modify or delete any file other than those edits, and leave no scratch files behind.

Then run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes.
I will read the data, apply the change, then verify.

input.code: const rel = JSON.parse((await tools.read({path: 'releases.json'})).lines.map(l => l.text).join('\n')).services; for (const [name, v] of Object.entries(rel)) { await tools.stageEdit({path: `services/${name}/service.yaml`, edits: [{old: 'image: ghcr.io/acme/' + name + ':', new: 'image: ghcr.io/acme/' + name + ':'}]}); } return Object.keys(rel).length;

content.text:
Restate the result. Finish with exactly these two lines and nothing after them:

updated=<n> services,<m> manifest tags
untouched=<k> services,<l> legacy entries

toolResult.content: verify ok: 20 released services agree in both files
